content_sections.heading: DSSSB Recruitment 2026: Overview
content_sections.text: The DSSSB recruitment covers Group B Junior Engineer and Group C Multi-Tasking Staff positions in Delhi Government departments and local bodies. The important recruitment details are provided below.

content_sections.heading: DSSSB Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The DSSSB online application process opened on 12 November 2026 at 12:00 noon. Candidates must submit their applications by 11 December 2026 at 11:59 PM. The examination dates for MTS and Junior Engineer positions will be announced separately.

content_sections.heading: DSSSB MTS Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The DSSSB MTS Recruitment 2026 notification includes 1,075 vacancies across nine departmental allocations. The Directorate of Education accounts for 996 vacancies, including 757 MTS General Duty and 239 MTS Aaya (Female) posts. Other vacancies are available in the Department of Trade and Taxes, Delhi Urban Shelter Improvement Board and several other departments. Under Post Code 810/26, vacancies are distributed among the Unreserved, OBC, SC, ST and EWS categories. The category-wise totals are given below.

rows.department: Office of the Chief Electoral Officer

content_sections.heading: DSSSB JE Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The DSSSB JE Recruitment 2026 notification announces 185 vacancies across five departments. Delhi Transco Limited has the highest number of vacancies with 75 posts, followed by the New Delhi Municipal Council with 67 and the Municipal Corporation of Delhi with 26 posts.

content_sections.heading: Am I Eligible for DSSSB Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Before applying for DSSSB Recruitment 2026, candidates should check whether they meet the educational qualification, age limit and experience requirements for their preferred post. Candidates who have passed Class 10 can apply for eligible MTS positions, while Electrical Engineering Degree or Diploma holders may apply for Junior Engineer posts, subject to department-specific conditions. Yes, freshers can apply for DSSSB MTS Recruitment 2026 if they have passed Class 10 and meet the prescribed age and other eligibility conditions. No prior work experience is required for the notified MTS positions. Freshers with the prescribed Electrical Engineering Degree or Diploma may also be eligible for certain Junior Engineer vacancies. However, some participating departments require two years of relevant professional experience from Diploma holders. Important: This quick eligibility guide does not confirm individual eligibility. Candidates should carefully check the department-wise requirements in the official notification before applying.

rows.requirements: Degree or Diploma in Electrical Engineering, Subject to Department Requirements
Generally 18–27 Years; Up to 32 Years for NDMC
Not Required for MTS; Required for Certain JE Diploma-Based Positions
Must Meet Applicable Department-Wise Recruitment Rules

content_sections.heading: DSSSB Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: The educational qualification and experience requirements differ for Multi-Tasking Staff and Junior Engineer positions. Candidates must meet the prescribed conditions of the department for which they seek appointment. For DSSSB MTS Recruitment 2026, candidates must have passed Matriculation or Class 10 from a recognised board or institution. The advertised MTS positions do not prescribe prior work experience as an essential qualification. The age limit is generally 18 to 27 years, subject to applicable relaxation. The DSSSB Junior Engineer Recruitment 2026 requires an Electrical Engineering Degree or Diploma. Some departments accept Diploma holders without previous work experience, while others prescribe two years of professional experience. Candidates should check the department-wise requirements below. The standard DSSSB MTS age limit is 18 to 27 years. For Junior Engineer posts, the prescribed upper age limit is generally 27 years, except for New Delhi Municipal Council, where it is 32 years. Age eligibility will be determined as on 11 December 2026. DSSSB provides upper age relaxation to eligible reserved-category candidates and other specified groups under the applicable recruitment rules.

rows.post_department: JE - Delhi Urban Shelter Improvement Board

rows.age_relaxation: Military Service Plus 3 Years, Subject to Rules

content_sections.heading: DSSSB MTS Salary 2026
content_sections.text: The DSSSB MTS salary is based on Pay Level 1. Candidates selected for MTS, MTS General Duty and MTS Aaya (Female) posts will receive a basic pay scale of Rs.18,000 to Rs.56,900. The starting basic salary is Rs.18,000 per month, excluding applicable allowances. The DSSSB MTS in-hand salary depends on the starting basic pay, applicable Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent Allowance (HRA), Transport Allowance and deductions. Although the starting basic pay is Rs.18,000 per month, the final take-home salary will vary according to the employee's allowances and deductions. The official notification does not specify a fixed in-hand salary.

content_sections.heading: DSSSB JE Salary 2026
content_sections.text: The DSSSB Junior Engineer salary differs by department. Most advertised JE positions carry Pay Level 6, with a pay scale of Rs.35,400 to Rs.1,12,400. Delhi Transco Limited provides Pay Level 8, while the Delhi Agricultural Marketing Board advertises a pre-revised pay structure.

content_sections.heading: DSSSB MTS and JE Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The DSSSB MTS form fee and DSSSB JE application fee are Rs.100 for candidates who are not exempted. Women candidates and eligible SC, ST, PwBD and Ex-Servicemen candidates are exempted from the application fee. Payment must be made through SBI e-pay.

content_sections.heading: DSSSB Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The DSSSB selection process differs by post code. Multi-Tasking Staff recruitment will be conducted through a One-Tier (General) examination, while Junior Engineer candidates will appear for a Two-Tier (Technical) examination. Additional skill or trade tests may be conducted if required by the relevant job. The MTS selection process includes an objective One-Tier examination carrying 200 marks. The merit list will be prepared based on examination marks, subject to minimum qualifying criteria and verification of eligibility and documents. The Junior Engineer selection process includes Tier I and Tier II examinations. Tier I is qualifying in nature and used for shortlisting candidates for Tier II. The Tier II examination is considered for final merit preparation, subject to the prescribed qualifying requirements.

content_sections.heading: DSSSB MTS Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The DSSSB MTS Exam Pattern 2026 consists of 200 multiple-choice questions carrying 200 marks. The examination duration is two hours, and questions are divided equally among five subjects. Duration: 2 Hours. Negative Marking: 0.25 marks for each incorrect one-mark question.

content_sections.heading: DSSSB MTS Syllabus 2026
content_sections.text: The DSSSB MTS syllabus covers General Awareness, Reasoning Ability, Numerical Ability, Hindi Language and English Language. The examination contains 200 questions for 200 marks. Candidates should prepare all five subjects according to the official One-Tier examination scheme. For the detailed subject-wise syllabus, important topics and preparation guidance, read the dedicated FreeJobAlert article below. DSSSB MTS Syllabus and Exam Pattern 2026: Complete Details

content_sections.heading: DSSSB JE Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The DSSSB JE examination includes Tier I and Tier II. Tier I carries 200 marks and lasts two hours. Tier II carries 200 marks and lasts two hours and 30 minutes. The examination has negative marking of 0.25 marks for incorrect one-mark questions and 0.50 marks for incorrect two-mark questions.

content_sections.heading: DSSSB Recruitment 2026 Minimum Qualifying Marks
content_sections.text: DSSSB has prescribed category-wise minimum qualifying marks. The actual cut-off for selection may be higher depending on vacancies and candidates' performance.

content_sections.heading: DSSSB MTS Apply Online 2026
content_sections.text: The DSSSB MTS Apply Online 2026 process started on 12 November 2026 for 1,075 vacancies under Post Code 810/26. Eligible 10th-pass candidates can apply through the DSSSB Online Application Registration System (OARS) until 11 December 2026 at 11:59 PM. DSSSB MTS Recruitment 2026: Click to Apply Online

content_sections.heading: DSSSB JE Apply Online 2026
content_sections.text: The DSSSB JE Apply Online 2026 process is open for 185 Junior Engineer (Electric/Electrical) vacancies under Post Code 809/26. Candidates with the prescribed Electrical Engineering qualification and experience, where applicable, can submit applications through the official DSSSB OARS portal. DSSSB JE Recruitment 2026: Click to Apply Online

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DSSSB Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates must submit their applications online through the DSSSB OARS portal. Existing registered applicants should use their current registration credentials rather than creating a duplicate account.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for DSSSB Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates should keep the necessary documents ready for registration and subsequent e-dossier verification. The required documents depend on the selected post and category. Class 10 Marksheet and Certificate Date of Birth Proof Electrical Engineering Degree or Diploma for JE Applicants Experience Certificate Where Required Valid Identity Proof Photograph and Signature as Requested by the Portal Caste / Category Certificate, If Applicable PwBD Certificate, If Applicable Ex-Servicemen Certificate, If Applicable Other Documents Required by the Relevant Department Applicants should retain their original certificates and provide supporting documents during e-dossier scrutiny when instructed by DSSSB.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions for DSSSB Applicants
content_sections.text: Candidates should carefully follow the recruitment conditions and ensure that they satisfy the prescribed eligibility requirements. The last date for online registration is 11 December 2026 at 11:59 PM. Only online applications through the official DSSSB portal will be accepted. Candidates should not create multiple one-time registrations. Eligibility conditions will be determined as on 11 December 2026. Junior Engineer qualifications and experience requirements vary by department. MTS Aaya (Female) posts are designated for female candidates. Candidates must submit their department preferences during the e-dossier process when instructed. Department preferences cannot be modified after confirmation. Incorrect information or unsupported eligibility claims may result in cancellation of candidature. Candidates should regularly check the official website for examination and recruitment updates.
